basis: Read standard JSDoc attached to exported functions in one JavaScript text-file reading.

cases.claim: A documented re-export uses its public alias and retains the upstream callable signature.
cases.test: reads JSDoc attached to a re-export of an imported function

cases.claim: Invalid text-file carriers and malformed JavaScript refuse before emitting documentation.
cases.test: refuses invalid carriers and invalid JavaScript

cases.claim: An installed caller can read the public name, description, parameter and return type of a documented function.
